---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new tool, tool group, or enhancement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem or motivation

What problem does this feature solve? What are you currently unable to do? Example: "I cannot download an SSL certificate via the MCP server because..."

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature you would like. If you are requesting a new tool, include:

- Proposed tool name (e.g. `combell_ssl_certificates_download`)
- The Combell API endpoint it maps to (e.g. `GET /v2/sslcertificates/{sha1Fingerprint}/download`)
- The key input parameters it should accept
- The expected output

## Alternatives considered

Describe any alternative approaches or workarounds you have tried.

## Additional context

Links to the Combell API documentation, screenshots, or other context that would help understand the request.
